title: Stack Scout // Updates
summary: Public-safe activity stream seeded from official or first-party sources.

items.title: Midas Project alleges covert right-wing influencer push for Nvidia chip sales to China
items.summary: The Midas Project says over 80 influencers likely received payment for mostly undisclosed pro-AI-industry promotions.

items.title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t —keep financing neoclouds
items.summary: If Nvidia is backstopping a data center loan, it won't be on the hook unless the neocould has independent financing and gets the facility built, with Nvidia gear installed, interim CEO Colette Kress explained.

items.title: Elon Musk’s one-word verdict on the Grimes AI-joke meet-cute story: “True”
items.summary: Musk quote-posted an account claiming a shared Roko’s Basilisk joke brought them together, without elaborating on its details.

items.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
items.summary: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

items.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
items.summary: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups including Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

items.title: Muse voice lands on Apple Watch and Wear OS, Alexandr Wang says
items.summary: Alexandr Wang says you can now talk to Muse on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon pricing reportedly surfaces. Hold the launch party.
items.summary: Gemini 4 Neon reportedly has $3 input and $15 output pricing per million tokens; availability is still unconfirmed.

items.title: TuXinming says Claude’s training diet included protein sequences at scale
items.summary: TuXinming reports that only the latest Claude models predicted continuations of little-studied bacterial proteins.

items.title: Kimmonismus: Anthropic researcher says broadly superhuman AI could be 1.3 years away
items.summary: A separate post quotes Anthropic researcher Tao Lin predicting permanent unemployment for nearly everyone because of AI.

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
items.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

items.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
items.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?

items.title: Jason Wei is joining Mercor as chief scientist. He knows the customer side.
items.summary: Wei will help build Mercor’s research team and shape its data and evaluations work, according to Brendan Foody.

items.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
items.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

items.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.

items.title: Make opened its CLI to all users
items.summary: Make's 2026 release notes show the Make CLI becoming available to all users, continuing the platform's expansion beyond the browser UI.

items.title: GitHub MCP Server reached 1.0.0
items.summary: The official GitHub MCP server hit 1.0.0 with granular issue field tooling and broader MCP Apps support behind feature flags.

items.title: GitHub CLI 2.90.0 introduced `gh skill` in public preview
items.summary: The latest GitHub CLI release adds search, install, preview, update, and publish flows for portable agent skills.

items.title: Hugging Face added Kernels to the Hub
items.summary: The Hub changelog added Kernels as a new way to browse precompiled, hardware-specific kernels and also continues to push agent traces into the product story.

items.title: Strudel Studio's latest public pass focused on smoke-run reliability
items.summary: The recent manager-side pass caught and fixed a release-smoke issue while keeping the studio workflow moving forward.

items.title: Canvas Planner stayed clean and review-ready in its latest public pass
items.summary: The latest public-ready manager pass kept the board surface fast and uncluttered while tightening browser behavior.

items.title: Playwright MCP 0.0.70 landed as the latest maintenance release
items.summary: The current tagged release is a maintenance cut, while the docs continue to push Playwright MCP as a first-class browser layer for agent workflows.

items.title: n8n kept its March 2026 release line moving
items.summary: The March release notes show continued 1.12x shipping, while docs and blog updates highlight secrets-provider and workflow-hardening work.

items.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4
items.summary: GPT-5.4 arrived with native computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context, reinforcing OpenAI's focus on real agent workflows.

items.title: Perplexity doubled down on its product thesis in March 2026
items.summary: Perplexity's public blog framed 'The AI is the Computer' and kept tying that story to its API and device ambitions from late February.

items.title: Anthropic's current system-card set centers Claude Sonnet 4.6
items.summary: Anthropic's model materials list Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the current Sonnet generation and explicitly note API access among the active surfaces.

items.title: Wrangler 4.58.0 improved command grouping and auth ergonomics
items.summary: Cloudflare's Workers SDK release added grouped help categories, better auth token retrieval, and type generation on dev startup.
